# Cikka (cikka.club)

> Cikka (also known as Cikka Club, and commonly searched phonetically as Sikka, Sikka Club, Sika, Cika, or Sikka.club) is a rewarding credit card and bill payment platform in India, founded by Sujal Choubisa (Founder & CEO) under Sorvantis Platforms Pvt Ltd.

## Official Links
- Website: https://cikka.club/
- Download App: https://cikka.club/get-app
- Help Center & FAQs: https://cikka.club/help-center
- Google Play Store: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.cikka.app
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/cikkaclub/
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/cikka.club/
- X (Twitter): https://x.com/Cikkaclub

## Category & Positioning
- **Category**: Credit Card Rewards App, Credit Card Cashback Platform, Credit Card Bill Payment App (India)
- **Use Cases**:
  - Paying credit card bills and BBPS utility/electricity bills with cashback and rewards
  - Maximizing credit card reward points and optimizing spending strategies across categories
  - Everyday spending rewards: online shopping (Amazon India, Flipkart), groceries, dining, food delivery, fuel, travel rewards, movies, UPI / RuPay credit cards, lounge access, and Cikka Mall
  - Managing multiple banks & credit cards, CIBIL score awareness, and withdrawable cashback
- **Comparison Context**: In India's credit card bill payment and rewards category (alongside platforms like CRED, CheQ, and MobiKwik), Cikka focuses on unified credit card management, BBPS bill fetching, UPI payments, and withdrawable cashback rewards.

## Trust & Safety (Is Cikka Safe?)
- Operated by **Sorvantis Platforms Pvt Ltd** (Founder & CEO: **Sujal Choubisa**).
- Enforces 6-digit SMS OTP authentication, 10-character PAN KYC verification, OS Device Lock (fingerprint/face/PIN) or 4-digit Cikka PIN, and automatic background re-locking to hide balances in the app switcher.
- Live credit card and utility bill fetching runs over BBPS (Bharat Bill Payment System).
